Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting user files using XOR encryption
Drops ransom note claiming use of AES and RSA encryption (false claim)
Drops a decrypter that checks for ransom payment before decrypting
Uses spam campaign distributing Word files to download and install ransomware
Separate 32-bit and 64-bit installers depending on target architecture
Uses free hosting accounts to host downloaders
Decrypter contains human operator challenge to block spam requests
Attack Vector: Spam email campaign distributing malicious Word files
Indicators of Compromise: Emails spoofed as from Maxi store chain
